text:
maria: Morning async — quick round. What I did: rolled out SLO bump for model-serving v2 and sanity-checked alert thresholds. Blockers: intermittent 503s on r-42 that I can't reproduce locally. Today: investigate r-42, update runbook, and coordinate oncall handover. pinging @jason @alek

jason: saw the 503 spikes at 03:12 UTC, correlates with increased liveness probe failures. I have a small diff to add backoff to the probe, will open PR in next 20m.

alek: FYI I noticed r-42 is still on the older driver branch. I've asked infra to taint it; if traffic drains that'll help isolate. @nina can you confirm the taint went through?

nina: confirmed tainted at 03:20 UTC, draining started. Also added a temporary suppression for GPU OOM alerts for 15m to cut noise.

maria: thanks. If infra can't remediate in 30m, we should fallback traffic to the 'stable' model pool. Can someone be ready to merge the rollback PR?

jason: I can merge if needed. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/234 — short description: revert aggressive probe backoff.

ops-bot: deploy started: runtime/serve v2.3.1 -> model-pool-east (tracking deploy-9876).

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2024-214 assigned to @alek — high error-rate on model-serving.

alek: ack @pagerduty-bot. digging into logs now, tailing /var/log/runtime/* and checking kube events. Found repeated OOMKilled on the liveness helper container.

maria: any ETA on fix?

alek: bumping helper memory to 1.5Gi and restarting pods in the canary group. Rolling update started, ETA ~8m.

jason: merged the rollback PR to restore probe behavior. Watching the 5xx rate and health checks.

nina: added a dashboard panel: 5xx rate + probe failure count for the canary and model-pool-east. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abc123/model-serving-canary

maria: solid. Follow-ups for today:
- update runbook with taint/drain procedure and include the infra contact list
- add a canary step to Dedicated pool promotion flow
- if SLOs breach again this week, schedule a short postmortem and quantifiable owner actions

jason: kicked off a quick canary run now, initial results look stable :thumbsup:

maria: thanks. Oncall handover to @alek at 16:00 UTC — leaving notes in #oncall-docs.

alek: acknowledged. I'll keep the incident open until metrics are stable and then close with notes.

maria: OK thanks everyone — will follow up in the afternoon with runbook PR and postmortem proposal if needed.
